verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured "# Sentry Documentation" header). Doc pages are also served as agent-friendly .md URLs (e.g., /ai/agent-plugin.md, /product/agents.md). Beyond that, Sentry offers agent-oriented guidance: a one-command plugin that teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok how to set up Sentry, and an MCP server that can read its documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming llms.txt in practice, and no evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is.
